limitations: Write actions (cancel, promote_report, document process, collection update/add_document, report update) are verified only in the local real-stdio fake-API contract and the clean-install lane; production performs no writes.

The operator account had no saved mission views at run time, so tracelab_mission.views was compared against an empty REST list in production; the item shape and UI-equivalent links are covered by the local contract and vitest.
The MCP Package workflow is not a required main context (Sprint 53 deferral in decision #426), so its post-merge run id is cited explicitly rather than enforced by branch protection.
Lint is not claimed: eslint is not installed in the package and the MCP Package workflow has no lint step.
Destructive deletes stay REST/UI-only with 'no approval recorded'; Derek's decision #426 question 2 remains open.
The action count is 51, not the planned 50: the repeatable reason filter extends tracelab_mission.list instead of adding an action.
closure_gate: CMOS MCP-2 remains In Progress until this receipt is merged on main and the receipt-carrier main push (including the non-required MCP Package run) and both Railway deployments are verified; those facts are recorded in the CMOS session closure.
